name: Snare
text: When an enemy monster attacks, cancel that attack.

name: Mirror Sigil
text: When an enemy monster attacks, it loses {MIRROR_SIGIL_PENALTY} Power permanently before combat.

name: Last Rites
text: When your monster is destroyed, draw {LAST_RITES_DRAW|card|cards}.

name: Thornwall
text: When you are attacked directly, take no damage and switch the attacker to guard.
